recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If HL7 wants to repair or republish the old 2015May DAF page, handle that through the archived/static publication process rather than current FHIR core source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-8128 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core ValueSet correction from the 2015May DAF ballot asking to fix the DAF BodySite value set page at 2015May/valueset-daf-bodysite.html, whose generated text showed an error message beginning 'This value set ... Error unmarshalling resource ...'.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6557. In git, 0e35b67873e4b1f06b4521628550d4e65a3bd2d7 changed the old terminology-service expansion path to pass limit/incomplete parameters, added too-costly narrative handling, and updated cached expansions, including the DAF BodySite cache entry, from an error outcome to a limited expansion.
additional_context: source/terminologies/valueset-daf-bodysite.xml remains in the repository as a retained terminology/OID artifact, but it is not listed in source/fhir.ini's active [valuesets] section. source/igs.xml comments out DAF and QICore IG entries, and build.fhir.org returns 404 for checked DAF BodySite page URLs. Current BodyStructure/body-site content is maintained separately under the active BodyStructure resource.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Editing the remaining out-of-build DAF BodySite XML or historical release snapshots would not correct a current FHIR build artifact, and the recorded historical tooling/cache fix already applied the ballot request.

related_jiras.note: The same svn revision 6557 implemented the companion large-value-set display behavior, but it is a separate request and was not decided here.
